rrf_470.source: R-2026-10-26-04 per_question.csv (first=rrf, w=0); CI and diffs as logged in LAB_NOTEBOOK.md (exploratory)

ledger.claim: Consciousness is a specific mathematical/structural process (§1)
ledger.evidence: No operational test for consciousness exists; the framework only defines graph quantities.

ledger.claim: The framework is "testable … for instantiating synthetic consciousness" (§1)
ledger.evidence: Same; only engineering sub-claims below are testable.

ledger.claim: An external graph memory supplies cross-turn statefulness missing from a context-limited LLM (§2.1, §5.2)
ledger.evidence: Synthetic: Sandwich 94/120 vs plain 0/120. Says nothing about graph vs. simpler memory (P-04).

ledger.claim: The graph memory is better than plain vector retrieval (implicit in §2.2, §6)
ledger.evidence: Synthetic: RAG 113/120 > Sandwich 94/120. LongMemEval-S (n=470) turn_any@10: v1 0.819 vs cosine 0.855, Δ −0.036 [−0.062, −0.011], sign-flip p 0.009, Holm 0.055 (borderline); BM25 0.857. Worse at @1 (0.164 vs 0.353) and nDCG@10 (0.420 vs 0.522). Caveat: MiniLM truncates 34% of turns at 256 word-pieces.

ledger.claim: W = S·T·(1+E)·R carries useful structure (Eq. 1)
ledger.status_raw: refuted for the weights; topology matters (R-2026-10-20-01, R-2026-10-26-02)
ledger.evidence: Shuffled W vs v1: recall@10 +0.006 [−0.015, 0.028], nDCG@10 +0.040 [0.026, 0.055] (shuffled is *better*). Random topology: recall@10 −0.062 [−0.085, −0.038]. So which pairs are linked (top-k by τ) matters; the W values on them do not help.

ledger.claim: Semantic similarity S is a useful association term (Eq. 2)
ledger.evidence: Removing S from W: recall@10 +0.000 [−0.011, 0.011], nDCG@10 +0.012 [0.004, 0.020] (removal helps). S still defines the edges via τ and the seeds; only its role inside W is refuted.

ledger.claim: Temporal closeness T is a useful association term (Eq. 3)
ledger.evidence: Removing T: recall@10 +0.006 [−0.006, 0.019], nDCG@10 +0.014 [0.008, 0.021]. h = 7 days was not tuned.

ledger.claim: Emotion E is "the heuristic driving the routing of thought" / multiplies significance (§2.1, Eq. 1)
ledger.evidence: Removing E (lexicon arousal): recall@10 +0.015 [0.000, 0.030], nDCG@10 +0.021 [0.011, 0.032]. Caveat: lexicon valence is crude, and LongMemEval is not an emotional task.

ledger.claim: Hebbian reinforcement R improves behaviour with use (Eq. 4)
ledger.evidence: E3 cannot test (no learning ⇒ R≡1, see THEORY_V1 §4). Needs E9 (multi-session).

ledger.claim: (1+E_ij) is a valid multiplier (Eq. 1)
ledger.evidence: E ∈ [−1,1] gives zero/negative weights; v1 uses 1+κ_E·arousal.

ledger.claim: Conscious thought = A* optimal path with an emotion+logic heuristic (§3.2)
ledger.evidence: Optimality holds for admissible H (tests). Usefulness (R-2026-10-26-02): removing A* changes recall@10 by −0.002 [−0.006, 0.000] but nDCG@10 by −0.018 [−0.024, −0.013], so the path only reorders the top-10 a little. start ≠ goal in 66.8% of questions; goal is a gold turn in 16.4%.

ledger.claim: Random-walk "subconscious" surfaces useful associations (Eq. 6)
ledger.status_raw: refuted as first stage (R-2026-10-26-02) and as re-ranking bonus (R-2026-10-26-04)
ledger.evidence: Ranking by PPR activation (ζ = 0.85) is worse than ranking by the seed similarity itself (v1 vs cosine above). Less diffusion helps: ζ 0.5 nDCG +0.048, ζ 0.15 +0.071 vs ζ 0.85, i.e. the closer to plain cosine, the better. Multi-session (where associations should help most): v1 0.760 vs cosine 0.868.

ledger.claim: High C(t) means mutually supportive concepts are active (Eq. 7)
ledger.evidence: C_norm was highest on update probes (0.142 vs 0.039–0.046), i.e. when *conflicting* facts were co-active.

ledger.claim: Φ (Eq. 8) measures depth of consciousness at a moment
ledger.status_raw: not testable / refuted as a dynamic quantity
ledger.evidence: Consciousness: not testable. Eq. 8 has no time dependence (MATH_AUDIT #1). v1 Φ_dyn equals C_norm at convergence in every LongMemEval question (R-2026-10-26-03), so it adds nothing.

ledger.claim: Φ is a tractable analogue of IIT Φ (§2.3)
ledger.evidence: Eq. 8 is a weighted degree sum; no partition/integration term.

ledger.claim: τ_ij governs useful formation of new connections (Eq. 9)
ledger.evidence: E4 θ sweep / edge-density ablation.

ledger.claim: C(t) > λ ⇒ self-awareness (Eq. 10)
ledger.evidence: No observable for self-awareness; v1 keeps λ only as a refine trigger.

ledger.claim: C(t) < λ ⇒ primary response insufficient (§5.2)
ledger.evidence: AUROC(−C_norm → failure). Synthetic Sandwich-always: 0.671 [0.556, 0.782], but within contradiction probes only (post-hoc) 0.576 [0.393, 0.754], so it is mostly a probe-type confound. LongMemEval v1 misses: 0.653 [0.584, 0.719], below max cosine alone 0.719; residual after maxcos 0.564 [0.495, 0.630].

ledger.claim: Triggering refinement only when C < λ helps (§5.2)
ledger.evidence: λ-trigger 44/120 vs always-refine 94/120 (λ = 0.0532, chosen post hoc).

ledger.claim: Secondary LLM refinement improves the answer (§5.3)
ledger.evidence: Over plain: 94 vs 0. Over RAG: draft-in-prompt 94 < RAG 113; no-draft prompt 114 ≈ RAG 113 (exploratory). Self-refine without memory 0/120.

ledger.claim: Secondary LLM updates W directly (§5.3)
ledger.evidence: Unspecified mechanism (MATH_AUDIT #15); v1 replaces with success signal s.

ledger.claim: Outputs become emotionally weighted, creative, non-repetitive (§6)
ledger.evidence: No metric defined.

ledger.claim: Path to AGI / self-aware entities (§7)
ledger.evidence: Rhetorical.

ledger.claim: EEG/BCI-controlled hyper-parameters (§6 future)
ledger.evidence: Out of scope (no hardware).

ledger.claim: All W, T, F, R, C_norm, Φ_dyn bounded as specified
ledger.evidence: `tests/test_v1.py`

ledger.claim: Activation update converges to a unique fixed point (PPR)
ledger.evidence: ζ<1 contraction; `test_activation_fixed_point`

ledger.claim: H is admissible ⇒ A* returns the min-cost path
ledger.evidence: A* == Dijkstra on random graphs

ledger.claim: v1 graph retrieval recall@10 ≥ cosine on LongMemEval-S
Real W beats shuffled-W and random-topology controls
ledger.status_raw: mixed: ✓ vs random topology, ✗ vs shuffled W (R-2026-10-26-02)
ledger.evidence: See P-05.

ledger.claim: Each of S, T, E contributes (ablation lowers recall)
ledger.evidence: No ablation lowered recall@10; all three removals raised nDCG@10 (CIs > 0).

ledger.claim: A* path adds recall over ranking by activation alone
ledger.status_raw: refuted for recall, small nDCG gain (R-2026-10-26-02)
ledger.evidence: See P-11.

ledger.claim: Low C_norm predicts wrong answers / retrieval misses (AUROC > 0.5)
ledger.evidence: AUROC > 0.5 everywhere, but below or equal to max-cosine, and residual CIs touch 0.5. See P-18.

ledger.claim: Secondary prompt without the draft avoids anchoring on a wrong draft
ledger.evidence: 114/120 vs 94/120; not pre-registered.

ledger.claim: Recency-weighted input helps knowledge-update questions
ledger.evidence: Knowledge-update questions: recency 0.889 vs plain v1 0.944 recall@10; overall nDCG −0.017 [−0.028, −0.006].

ledger.claim: Every −log W path cost is invariant to rescaling R (THEORY_V1 v1.0 §4)
ledger.evidence: The −log cost adds a per-hop penalty of log W_max; 11/470 paths changed. Corrected in v1.1. Invariance holds for P and A only.

ledger.claim: Graph activation as a re-ranking bonus on a first stage improves recall@10 (v1.2 candidate)
ledger.evidence: Test half n=247, dev-chosen config: cosine Δ 0.000 [−0.016, 0.016]; RRF Δ 0.000 [0.000, 0.000]; Holm 1.0 both; shuffled W identical recall; larger w hurts (RRF w0.5 ζ0.85: 0.874 vs 0.907).

ledger.claim: RRF(BM25, cosine) beats each single retriever as a first stage (replication on a new dataset)
ledger.evidence: all_ev@10 over N=1,536: RRF 0.493 [0.469, 0.518]; −cosine +0.102 [0.081, 0.124], p_Holm 1e-4; −BM25 +0.026 [0.007, 0.045], p_Holm 0.010. Caveat: RRF−BM25 over conversation clusters +0.027 [−0.006, 0.063], better in 7/10; on the multi-hop ≥2-evidence subset (R-03, N=277) RRF−BM25 +0.047 [0.014, 0.079], Holm 0.13 and RRF−cosine +0.025 [−0.007, 0.061], Holm 1.0.

ledger.claim: Graph activation as a re-ranking bonus beats RRF on LoCoMo multi-hop all-evidence@10 by ≥ 0.03 (pre-registered H2)
ledger.evidence: N=277. S-only bonus (dev config): Δ 0.000 [0.000, 0.000] (identical outcome on all 277). Aggressive full-W config: +0.018 [−0.004, 0.043], Holm 1.0, below margin. v1 as first stage −0.025 [−0.058, 0.007]. Extends V-12 to a second dataset.

ledger.claim: Real association weights W beat shuffled W
ledger.evidence: Primary all_ev@10: rr_strong − shuffled +0.022 [0.000, 0.043] (p 0.11); S-only identical to shuffled. Secondary frac@10 (uncorrected, one shuffle seed): +0.024 [+0.004, +0.045]; opposite sign from LongMemEval-S (P-05). No single S/T/E ablation reproduces it.

ledger.claim: kNN topology beats random edges (LoCoMo)
ledger.evidence: v1 − random topology all_ev@10 +0.022 [+0.007, +0.040], raw p 0.030, Holm 0.57; frac@10 +0.058 [+0.038, +0.078] (secondary, uncorrected).

ledger.claim: Graph-reranked context (rr_sonly) improves a small reader's LoCoMo multi-hop answer F1 over RRF context
ledger.evidence: N=277, Qwen2.5-1.5B, partial-F1. B − A = −0.0006 [−0.015, +0.013], Holm 0.94; pre-registered falsifier (CI upper < +0.02) fired. Low power by construction: contexts identical in order for most questions (12/277 answers differ).

ledger.claim: A draft in the secondary prompt hurts relative to no draft (anchoring; extends V-09 to LoCoMo)
ledger.evidence: D − C = +0.009 [−0.014, +0.032], Holm 0.89: no anchoring detected here; prediction (D − C < 0) not met. V-09 (synthetic, 114/120 vs 94/120) stands only for that synthetic task. The closed-book draft is weak (F1 0.145) and the 1.5B reader mostly ignores it when context is present.

ledger.claim: The Sandwich pipeline (v1 retrieval, with or without draft) answers better than plain RRF context
ledger.evidence: C − A = −0.038 [−0.075, −0.003], raw p 0.037, Holm 0.11 (pre-registered); D − A = −0.029 [−0.067, +0.008], p 0.13 (exploratory). Not significant after Holm, but no sign of a gain. Retrieval upstream is worse (all-evidence in context 0.079 vs 0.105).

runs.date_note: v0 run predates the notebook (date from the run ID; time not logged); backfilled 2026-10-26
runs.title: v0 synthetic: plain / self-refine / RAG / Sandwich (n=120)
runs.verdict: Exploratory. RAG 113/120 > Sandwich 94/120; dropping the draft gives 114. Draft contamination found.

runs.title: E3 smoke test (--limit 10)
runs.verdict: Checks that the code runs; numbers not interpreted.

runs.title: E3: LongMemEval-S retrieval, graph vs BM25/cosine + controls/ablations (n=470)
runs.verdict: V-04 refuted: v1 − cosine −0.036 [−0.062, −0.011]. Weights ≈ shuffled; topology > random.
held: lower ζ moves v1 toward cosine
failed: v1_noR identical to v1: 11/470 A* paths differed (−log W is not scale-invariant), a spec error fixed in v1.1

runs.title: E2: does low C_norm predict failure? (AUROC)
runs.verdict: Weak evidence. AUROC 0.63–0.68, below max-cosine for v1/cosine misses; residual 0.56–0.59. Pre-registration flaw logged: no primary label named.
held: max-cos ≥ C_norm for v1 and cosine misses
residual CI includes 0.5 for v1 misses (0.564 [0.495, 0.630])
failed: cosine misses: AUROC above the range (0.679)
residual CI includes 0.5 for cosine and BM25 misses (both barely exclude it)

runs.title: E3b: graph as a re-ranking bonus, dev/test split (test n=247)
runs.verdict: V-12 refuted: Δ 0.000 [−0.016, +0.016] (cosine), 0.000 [0, 0] (RRF). Unplanned: RRF alone 0.913 (exploratory).
held: primary Δ ≤ +0.01 with CI containing 0, both first stages

runs.title: E5/E6 skipped (decision logged before running)
runs.verdict: Synthetic task is saturated (120/120 recall); end-to-end QA judge needs paid API or GPU.

runs.title: Confirm RRF(BM25, cosine) on LoCoMo (N=1,536)
runs.verdict: H1 confirmed: RRF − cosine +0.102 [0.081, 0.124]; RRF − BM25 +0.026 [0.007, 0.045] (clustered CI includes 0).
held: H1 rule: both diffs > 0, both Holm p < 0.05

runs.title: Aborted: BLAS thread oversubscription (no result looked at)
runs.verdict: Killed, root cause fixed (thread pinning only), re-run under the same pre-registration.

runs.title: LoCoMo multi-hop: graph vs RRF, controls, ablations (N=277)
runs.verdict: H2 FALSIFIED (both falsifiers fired). Best graph +0.018 [−0.004, +0.043] < +0.03 bar; nothing survives Holm.
held: real ≈ shuffled within ±0.02 for rr_sonly and v1
random topology worse than real topology

runs.title: End-to-end QA, Qwen2.5-1.5B reader, LoCoMo multi-hop F1 (N=277)
runs.verdict: Graph context = RRF context: −0.0006 [−0.015, +0.013]. Falsifier for 'graph helps the reader' fired.
held: falsifier for 'graph helps the reader' fired
failed: D − C < 0, i.e. the draft anchors the refine pass (observed +0.009, no anchoring)
